description: ΑΡΧΕΙΟ ΓΡΑΦΕΙΟΥ ΦΥΣΙΚΗΣ ΑΓΩΓΗΣ is a dataset listed in data.gov.gr, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by ΓΑΚ – Αρχεία-Ν.Ροδόπης. URAD ZA FIZIČNO IZOBRAŽEVANJE (1950–1997). Raziskovalno orodje. GAK - Arhiv prefekture Rodopi. Podatki, pridobljeni iz programske opreme GAC @archiomnimon. Coverage: ΓΑΚ – Αρχεία-Ν.Ροδόπης. The portal shows the English title as "FIZIKAI OKTATÁSI IRODA ARCHÍVUMA" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is ΓΑΚ – Αρχεία-Ν.Ροδόπης. Its keywords include Εργαλεία έρευνας, Αρχεία, repository.data.gov.gr, Τμήμα ΓΑΚ Ροδόπης, Από μετάπτωση, Γενικά Αρχεία του Κράτους. The listing shows 1 download or service links in XLS. The listing shows 2026-02-23 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-data-gov-gr.
